entities.summary: David C. Gunther was an American basketball player and coach. He served as the head basketball coach at the University of North Dakota from 1970 to 1988. Gunther played college basketball for the Iowa Hawkeyes and professional basketball with the San Francisco Warriors of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
